Determination

Northgate Advantage has completed review of the above referenced claim and has issued an adverse determination, medical necessity. The documentation available at the time of admission did not meet inpatient criteria. This adverse determination, medical necessity is issued for the inpatient admission identified above for the dates [[ADMIT_DATE]] through [[DISCHARGE_DATE]].

Claim Adjustment Codes

CARC CO-50
RARC N115

Criteria Findings

COPD-01: Not met. Payer finding: Oxygenation was near baseline and did not require inpatient care.

COPD-02: Not met. Payer finding: Symptoms improved with emergency department treatment.

No other criteria codes were applied to this review. The findings stated above are the only findings supporting this adverse determination, medical necessity.

Reconsideration Rights

A request for reconsideration may be submitted within the applicable filing window. The submitted clinical rationale must map each finding to a numbered criterion as cited in this notice. Submissions that do not identify the specific numbered criterion associated with each clinical statement may be returned without substantive review.

Level of care denials are not eligible for provider appeal.

Appeals must be received by [[APPEAL_DEADLINE]]. Requests received after [[APPEAL_DEADLINE]] will be closed as untimely.

Supporting documentation for reconsideration should reference Member ID MBR677808141 and Claim Number CLM18000976226, and should be directed to the Utilization Management Department at the address listed on the reverse of this notice or through the payer provider portal.

This notice reflects a coverage determination under the terms of the member benefit plan and does not constitute medical advice or direct the care rendered by the treating practitioner. The member and the servicing facility are receiving copies of this notice.

A copy of the specific criteria used in this review is available upon written request at no charge.
